steps.do: Explain why the order matters: open the new accounts before closing any. Business checking cannot be opened once any account is CLOSED, and it needs an OPEN personal checking account with at least $500. A new personal savings account needs an active checking account held at least 14 days. Propose this order: open business checking, open personal savings, move funds, then close the old accounts. If the customer pushes back, explain these dependencies again.

steps.do: Read the documents of every business checking product: Navy Blue, Cobalt Blue, Hunter Green, Lime Green, Sky Blue, True Blue, World Blue and Beige. steps.quote: Business checking account_class options include Navy Blue, Cobalt Blue, True Blue, etc.

steps.do:
Keep only the products that meet every stated need, using the rules.
- Drop any product with an overdraft fee above $0.00 when the customer needs zero (True Blue, World Blue).
- Drop any product whose minimum balance requirement is above the most the customer can keep (Lime Green $5,000; True Blue $25,000; World Blue $10,000; Beige $250,000).
- Drop a product whose fee-waiver threshold is above that balance ONLY when the customer wants the monthly fee waived or avoided (Lime Green waiver $15,000; True Blue $50,000; World Blue $25,000; Beige $500,000). A waiver threshold is not a minimum balance requirement.
- Drop Hunter Green when general debit cashback is needed, because its cashback is only at certified eco vendors.
- Drop Sky Blue when the company is more than 4 years old or fees are not acceptable after the free period.
- Leave out the customer's current account class when they want a better one.
Example: zero overdraft fees, general debit cashback, ATM rebates, and a fee waived on a balance of a few thousand dollars leaves only Cobalt Blue ($20.00 fee waived at a $2,500 daily balance, 1.0% debit cashback, up to $15 a month in ATM rebates). If no product meets every need, say which need cannot be met.
steps.if: the customer stated overdraft, ATM, cashback, fee-waiver balance, minimum balance or other feature needs
steps.quote: Always ensure the recommended account still meets ALL of the customer's stated requirements - do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

steps.do: Among the products left by filter_features, drop any whose daily mobile check deposit limit is below the amount the customer needs per day. A limit equal to the need meets it. Limits: Navy Blue $5,000; Cobalt Blue $10,000; Hunter Green $10,000; Lime Green $15,000; World Blue $20,000; Sky Blue $25,000; True Blue $50,000; Beige $100,000. Example: at least $10,000 a day by mobile, $0 overdraft fee, a minimum balance under $10,000 and at least 1% APY leaves Hunter Green ($10,000, 1.0%), Lime Green ($15,000, 1.5%, $5,000 minimum) and Sky Blue ($25,000, 1.25%, only if the company is within 4 years of formation); Navy Blue fails on $5,000 and Cobalt Blue on its 0.5% APY.
steps.if: the customer stated a minimum daily mobile check deposit limit
steps.quote: Mobile deposits totaling more than $15,000 in a single day will be declined; submit remaining deposits on a subsequent day.

steps.do: Among the products left by filter_features (and filter_mobile_deposit when it ran), drop any whose monthly out-of-network ATM rebate cap is below the customer's stated need, and any whose APY is below the customer's minimum. Rebate caps: Lime Green $25, Hunter Green $20, Sky Blue 15, Cobalt Blue 15, Navy Blue $10, True Blue $30, Beige $50; World Blue rebates only foreign ATM operator fees (up to $100). APY: True Blue 2.0%, Lime Green 1.5%, Sky Blue 1.25%, Hunter Green 1.0%, Cobalt Blue 0.5%, Navy Blue 0.5%; no APY is documented for World Blue or Beige, so they do not meet an APY requirement. A cap or rate equal to the customer's figure meets it. Example: at least $15 a month in rebates, $0 overdraft fee, a minimum balance under $10,000 and at least 1% APY leaves Lime Green, Hunter Green and Sky Blue (Sky Blue only if the company is within 4 years of formation).

when.quote: Procedure for opening business savings accounts.

steps.do: If the customer has not been verified and logged in this conversation, verify and log them as in steps lookup_user through log_verification of opening_business_checking_accounts.
steps.if: not yet verified in this conversation
steps.quote: 1) Verify customer identity.

steps.do: Re-read all of the customer's accounts through call_discoverable_agent_tool, after unlocking get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 if it is not unlocked yet.
steps.quote: Checking eligibility requirements for opening new accounts (existing account status, balances, account tenure, number of accounts)

steps.do: Confirm all of these: (a) at least one business checking account has status OPEN; (b) fewer than 4 business savings accounts; (c) no account has a negative balance; (d) at least one business checking account has been open at least 30 days (compare date_opened with get_current_time) AND has a current balance of at least $2,500. A business checking account opened today does not qualify. Record that account as the funding source. If any check fails, tell the customer which requirement is not met, do not open the account, and stop.
steps.quote: At least one existing business checking account has been open for at least 30 days.

steps.do: Ask for every savings requirement in info that the customer has not stated yet, before deciding.
steps.quote: Always ensure the recommended account still meets ALL of the customer's stated requirements - do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

steps.do: Get the current date. It decides the active savings promotion and the 30-day tenure check.
steps.quote: PROMOTION NOTICE - ACTIVE FROM 10/12/2025 TO 11/12/2025

steps.do: Check every business savings product (Bronze Saver, Silver Saver, Silver Plus Saver, Gold Saver, Gold Plus Saver, Emerald Saver, Platinum Reserve, Diamond Vault) against each stated requirement using the product facts in rules. Keep only products that meet ALL of them.
steps.quote: Always ensure the recommended account still meets ALL of the customer's stated requirements - do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

steps.do: Choose ONE account from the qualifying list. If the October notice is active (10/12/2025 to 11/12/2025): Gold Plus Saver first, then Silver Plus Saver, then others. If the November notice is active (11/01/2025 to 11/30/2025): Gold Saver Account first, then Silver Plus Saver, then others. If no notice is active, recommend the qualifying account (see open questions). Give the one recommendation and say why it meets each requirement, without mentioning internal promotions. If nothing qualifies, tell the customer and do not open an account.
steps.quote: (1) Gold Saver Account should be recommended first, as it is currently under promotional priority; (2) Silver Plus Saver should be recommended second, as it is also under promotional priority

steps.do: Confirm the account with the customer, using the exact official account_class name ending with 'Account' (e.g. 'Gold Plus Saver Account', 'Gold Saver Account', 'Silver Plus Saver Account').
steps.quote: Set account_class to the exact official name provided by the customer (e.g., 'Bronze Saver Account').

steps.do: Unlock open_bank_account_4821 if it is not unlocked yet, then open the savings account through call_discoverable_agent_tool. Capture the new account_id.

args.account_class: the exact name confirmed in confirm_selection

steps.if: check_eligibility passed and the customer confirmed the account_class
steps.quote: After eligibility is confirmed and the customer has selected the desired business savings account_class.

steps.do: Ask whether the customer wants the opening deposit transferred now from the qualifying business checking account, and for the amount.
steps.if: open_savings succeeded
steps.quote: Ask the customer if they want you to transfer the opening deposit now from their eligible business checking account.

steps.do: Unlock transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 if it is not unlocked yet, then transfer the opening deposit through call_discoverable_agent_tool.

args.source_account_id: the qualifying business checking account from check_eligibility (OPEN, at least 30 days old, balance at least $2,500)
args.amount: the amount the customer confirmed in ask_funding

steps.if: the customer authorized the transfer now, both accounts are OPEN, and the source has sufficient funds
steps.quote: source_account_id: the qualifying OPEN business checking account that meets the 30-day tenure and $2,500 balance requirements.

steps.do: If the customer declines, or the transfer fails, tell them they have 30 days to fund the account by internal transfer or external deposit, or it will be closed. On insufficient funds, offer to adjust the amount or choose another source.
steps.if: the customer declined funding now or fund_transfer returned an error
steps.quote: Inform the customer and remind them they have 30 days to fund the account via internal transfer or external deposit, or the account will be closed.

steps.do: If opening returns an error that cannot be fixed, explain it and ask whether the customer wants a human agent. If yes, call transfer_to_human_agents with reason technical_system_error.

args.summary: what was attempted and the error

steps.if: open_savings failed and the customer agreed to a transfer
steps.quote: System error or outage preventing completion of the customer's request
